__inputs.label: SQL Server
__inputs.description: The SQL Server datasource holding your UtilityUsage table

description: Utility-reported usage imported from Green Button downloads by RtlAmrCapture. Reads dbo.UtilityUsageIntervals, which the service creates on first start.

panels.description: Usage for the most recent full local day the utility has reported. Utilities usually publish interval data about a day late.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT CAST(IntervalStart AT TIME ZONE '${tz}' AS date) AS LocalDay, [Value]
  FROM dbo.UtilityUsageIntervals
  WHERE SourceName = '${source}' AND ServiceKind = '${service}' AND FlowDirection = 1
)
SELECT TOP 1 SUM([Value]) AS value
FROM d
WHERE LocalDay < (SELECT MAX(LocalDay) FROM d)
GROUP BY LocalDay
ORDER BY LocalDay DESC;

panels.title: Last Full Day (${unit})

panels.description: Average daily usage over the 7 most recent full days reported.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT CAST(IntervalStart AT TIME ZONE '${tz}' AS date) AS LocalDay, [Value]
  FROM dbo.UtilityUsageIntervals
  WHERE SourceName = '${source}' AND ServiceKind = '${service}' AND FlowDirection = 1
),
daily AS (
  SELECT TOP 7 LocalDay, SUM([Value]) AS Total
  FROM d
  WHERE LocalDay < (SELECT MAX(LocalDay) FROM d)
  GROUP BY LocalDay
  ORDER BY LocalDay DESC
)
SELECT AVG(Total) AS value FROM daily;

panels.title: 7-Day Average (${unit}/day)

panels.description: Total cost reported in the selected time range. Empty if your utility does not include cost in the download.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(Cost) AS value
FROM dbo.UtilityUsageIntervals
WHERE SourceName = '${source}' AND ServiceKind = '${service}' AND FlowDirection = 1
  AND $__timeFilter(IntervalStart);

panels.title: Cost in Range

panels.description: End of the newest interval imported. If this falls more than a couple of days behind, download a fresh file.
panels.title: Data Through

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(LocalDay AS datetime2) AT TIME ZONE '${tz}' AS time, SUM([Value]) AS [Daily use]
FROM (
  SELECT CAST(IntervalStart AT TIME ZONE '${tz}' AS date) AS LocalDay, [Value]
  FROM dbo.UtilityUsageIntervals
  WHERE SourceName = '${source}' AND ServiceKind = '${service}' AND FlowDirection = 1
    AND $__timeFilter(IntervalStart)
) d
GROUP BY LocalDay
ORDER BY LocalDay;

panels.description: Each interval as the utility reported it. Breaks in the line are intervals the utility has no reading for, such as a power outage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT IntervalStart AS time, [Value] AS [Interval use]
FROM dbo.UtilityUsageIntervals
WHERE SourceName = '${source}' AND ServiceKind = '${service}' AND FlowDirection = 1
  AND $__timeFilter(IntervalStart)
ORDER BY IntervalStart;

panels.title: Interval Use (${unit})

panels.description: Average use per hourly interval by local hour of day, over the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT RIGHT('0' + CAST(LocalHour AS varchar(2)), 2) + ':00' AS [Hour], SUM([Value]) / COUNT(DISTINCT LocalDay) AS [Average use]
FROM (
  SELECT DATEPART(hour, IntervalStart AT TIME ZONE '${tz}') AS LocalHour,
         CAST(IntervalStart AT TIME ZONE '${tz}' AS date) AS LocalDay, [Value]
  FROM dbo.UtilityUsageIntervals
  WHERE SourceName = '${source}' AND ServiceKind = '${service}' AND FlowDirection = 1
    AND DurationSeconds <= 3600
    AND $__timeFilter(IntervalStart)
) h
GROUP BY LocalHour
ORDER BY LocalHour;

panels.title: Use by Time of Day (${unit} per hour)

panels.description: Stretches with no reading from the utility. A dead meter logs nothing, so power outages show up here. Generator-supplied use never reaches the utility's data.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT GapStart AS [From], GapEnd AS [To], DATEDIFF(minute, GapStart, GapEnd) / 60.0 AS [Hours missing]
FROM (
  SELECT DATEADD(second, DurationSeconds, IntervalStart) AS GapStart,
         LEAD(IntervalStart) OVER (ORDER BY IntervalStart) AS GapEnd
  FROM dbo.UtilityUsageIntervals
  WHERE SourceName = '${source}' AND ServiceKind = '${service}' AND FlowDirection = 1
    AND $__timeFilter(IntervalStart)
) g
WHERE GapEnd > GapStart
ORDER BY GapStart DESC;
